title: Honoring Veterans and Active Military
body_markdown:
This Veterans Day, we’re honoring the service and sacrifice of the brave individuals who’ve worn our nation’s uniform. **On Tuesday, November 11, all active-duty military personnel and veterans are invited to enjoy a ShackBurger for free** *.


## **How do I get Shake Shacks Veterans Day offer?**


Stop by any participating Shake Shack nationwide on 11/11/2026 and show a valid military ID or proof of service. Order in-Shack with one of our team members, and we’ll take care of the rest. It’s our way of saying thank you for everything you do.


***Terms and Conditions:**


*Offer only valid for qualifying orders placed and fulfilled in-Shack with a team member and fulfilled on 11/11/2026 ("Promotional Period") at participating Shake Shack locations (excluding airports, stadiums, arenas, travel plazas, and museums). Must present identification to confirm military service including but not limited to military ID and veteran designation on driver’s license. Offer not valid for orders made through the Shack Mobile App, via shakeshack.com, or through third party delivery apps and Shake Shack drive-thrus. Limit (one) free Single ShackBurger per order. One time use per order. Max saving of $9.99. Must add at least one (1) Single ShackBurger to cart. Offer excludes any applicable taxes or fees, including service fees or paid add-ons. Offer excludes all paid add-ons such as avocado and bacon. While supplies last. Cannot be combined with any other offers or promotions.*
